description: Nobu is an AI agent that monitors supported purchases after checkout and alerts users when a lower retailer price may be available. Users can describe a purchase in natural language, review the details Nobu extracts, confirm the exact product, and start monitoring. AI understands the purchase information, while deterministic retailer rules and fail-closed exact-product matching control every monitoring decision. The current live integration supports eligible Target.com purchases using third-party SerpApi shopping observations. Target verifies prices and makes the final adjustment decision.

input_example.purchase_text: I bought a 100-count bottle of up&up acetaminophen from Target online yesterday for $9.99.
